name: ffmpeg_tool
description: Free local/worker media inspection, delivery and fixed reframing. Fixed operations only; no commands, filtergraphs, URLs or network access. Always execute on the machine containing job_id. Missing binaries fail softly; Lambda hosts without ffmpeg cannot run binary ops.

op.description: Allowed values: trim, measure_loudness, loudnorm_mux_aac, mux_aac, transcode_h264, frame_cadence, detect_black, detect_freeze, detect_silence, ssim, crop_plan_preview, reframe_crop, reframe_pad_blur, detect_scenes, probe, extract_frames, contact_sheet, sha256, check_faststart, volume_stats, burn_subtitles, export_srt, color_match_lut, audio_cleanup, make_proxy. One of: trim, measure_loudness, loudnorm_mux_aac, mux_aac, transcode_h264, frame_cadence, detect_black, detect_freeze, detect_silence, ssim, crop_plan_preview, reframe_crop, reframe_pad_blur, detect_scenes, probe, extract_frames, contact_sheet, sha256, check_faststart, volume_stats, burn_subtitles, export_srt, color_match_lut, audio_cleanup, make_proxy.

job_id.description: Existing job directory under RENDERHAUS_MEDIA_DIR. ASCII id, 1 to 80 characters.

input_path.description: Readable regular file inside this job. Relative path or confined absolute path. No URLs, traversal or option prefixes.

I.description: measure_loudness: Allowed range: -30 to -5. Default -14. loudnorm_mux_aac: Allowed range: -30 to -5. Default -14.

TP.description: measure_loudness: Allowed range: -9 to 0. Default -1.5. loudnorm_mux_aac: Allowed range: -9 to 0. Default -1.5.

LRA.description: measure_loudness: Allowed range: 1 to 20. Default 11. loudnorm_mux_aac: Allowed range: 1 to 20. Default 11.

bitrate_kbps.description: loudnorm_mux_aac: Allowed range: 64 to 320. Default 192. mux_aac: Allowed range: 64 to 320. Default 192.

measured_I.description: loudnorm_mux_aac: Required pass-one measured_I from this source at these targets; finite -99 to 0.

measured_TP.description: loudnorm_mux_aac: Required pass-one measured_TP from this source at these targets; finite -99 to 99.

measured_LRA.description: loudnorm_mux_aac: Required pass-one measured_LRA from this source at these targets; finite 0 to 99.

measured_thresh.description: loudnorm_mux_aac: Required pass-one measured_thresh from this source at these targets; finite -99 to 0.

offset.description: loudnorm_mux_aac: Required pass-one offset from this source at these targets; finite -99 to 99.

intent.description: transcode_h264: Fixed delivery intent; fit native dimensions without upscaling. One of: social-vertical, social-feed, web-1080p, broadcast-proxy, review-proxy, email-720p, podcast-streaming.

d.description: detect_black: Allowed range: 0.1 to 5. Default 0.5. detect_freeze: Allowed range: 0.1 to 5. Default 0.5. detect_silence: Allowed range: 0.1 to 5. Default 0.5.

reference_path.description: ssim: Required readable reference video confined to the same job directory.

aspect.description: crop_plan_preview: Target aspect enum. Nominal sizes come from the shared aspect table. reframe_crop: Target aspect enum. Nominal sizes come from the shared aspect table. One of: 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9, 2.39:1.

subject_box.description: crop_plan_preview: Optional box in displayed source pixels. x/y nonnegative, dimensions positive, within source. crop_box requires even integers; subject_box is only a crop-centre hint, never detection. reframe_crop: Optional box in displayed source pixels. x/y nonnegative, dimensions positive, within source. crop_box requires even integers; subject_box is only a crop-centre hint, never detection.

crop_box.description: crop_plan_preview: Optional box in displayed source pixels. x/y nonnegative, dimensions positive, within source. crop_box requires even integers; subject_box is only a crop-centre hint, never detection. reframe_crop: Optional box in displayed source pixels. x/y nonnegative, dimensions positive, within source. crop_box requires even integers; subject_box is only a crop-centre hint, never detection.

safe_zone.description: crop_plan_preview: Safe-zone fraction overrides top,bottom,side; leave at least 5% inner width/height. Null uses configured aspect placeholders. reframe_crop: Safe-zone fraction overrides top,bottom,side; leave at least 5% inner width/height. Null uses configured aspect placeholders. reframe_pad_blur: Safe-zone fraction overrides top,bottom,side; leave at least 5% inner width/height. Null uses configured aspect placeholders.

anchor.description: crop_plan_preview: Static centre or edge anchor. A supplied subject box takes precedence. reframe_crop: Static centre or edge anchor. A supplied subject box takes precedence. One of: center, top, bottom, left, right.

allow_upscale.description: crop_plan_preview: Allow crop/foreground resampling to table size; disclosed as no added detail. reframe_crop: Allow crop/foreground resampling to table size; disclosed as no added detail. reframe_pad_blur: Allow crop/foreground resampling to table size; disclosed as no added detail.

size.description: reframe_pad_blur: Target aspect enum. Nominal sizes come from the shared aspect table. One of: 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9, 2.39:1.

times.description: extract_frames: 1 to 20 frame times, each 0 to 600 seconds. Default [0].

width.description: extract_frames: Allowed range: 16 to 1920. Default 640. contact_sheet: Allowed range: 16 to 640. Default 320.

height.description: contact_sheet: Allowed range: 16 to 640. Default 180. make_proxy: 480 or 540 pixel height bound, fit native aspect and never upscale. Actual dimensions are reported.

subtitle_path.description: burn_subtitles: A confined regular local file inside the same job; no URLs, traversal or options.

input_path.description: A confined regular local file inside the same job; no URLs, traversal or options.

subtitle_path.description: A confined regular local file inside the same job; no URLs, traversal or options.

subtitle_batch.description: burn_subtitles: Up to four additional video/subtitle pairs, five total. Shared validated style; atomic cleanup on failure.

font_id.description: burn_subtitles: An approved installed DejaVu font. Missing fonts fail softly; imported ASS styles are replaced. One of: dejavu_sans, dejavu_serif, dejavu_mono.

colour.description: burn_subtitles: Fixed RGB subtitle colour as #RRGGBB.

cues.description: export_srt: 1 to 1000 UTF-8 timed-text cues. Finite sorted non-overlapping seconds, at least 1 ms apart; no control characters or blank lines.
1 to 1000 UTF-8 timed-text cues. Finite sorted non-overlapping seconds, at least 1 ms apart; no control characters or blank lines.

export_batch.description: export_srt: Up to four additional cue lists, five exports total. No transcription or provider calls.

lut_path.description: color_match_lut: Optional confined .cube LUT with size 2 to 33 and exact bounded finite RGB data. No LUT is bundled.

grade_preset.description: color_match_lut: Fixed grade table; applies after an optional LUT. Intensity blends the entire grade with the original. One of: none, warm, cool, contrast.

cleanup_preset.description: audio_cleanup: Fixed FFT noise-floor profile. This is spectral cleanup, not voice isolation. One of: dialogue, gentle, music.

eq_preset.description: audio_cleanup: Fixed bounded equalizer bands, never an arbitrary filter string. One of: neutral, dialogue, warm.

compressor.description: audio_cleanup: Enable the bounded compressor after highpass, FFT denoise and EQ. Normalize loudness afterwards.

proxy_preset.description: make_proxy: Fixed H.264 editing-proxy encoding preset. Output names derive from the source and never overwrite. One of: fast, veryfast, ultrafast.

params.description: Per-op parameters only. probe, sha256, check_faststart, volume_stats take no params. extract_frames uses times,width. contact_sheet uses every_s,cols,rows,width,height. Outputs never overwrite existing files.
